# airlock_group_agents (Data Source)

Read agents assigned to an Airlock policy group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "airlock_group_agents" "example" {
  group_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Airlock policy group ID.

### Read-Only

- `items_json` (String, Sensitive) JSON response returned by Airlock. Marked sensitive because administrative data may include environment details.
